newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cathay says Dec passenger, cargo loads up.
newsitem.headline: Cathay says Dec passenger, cargo loads up.

text.p: Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd said the airline carried 2.5 percent more passengers and 8.6 percent more cargo in December 1996 compared to the same month in 1995.
During the traditional peak period for passenger and cargo traffic, Cathay said in a statement it carried 1,003,583 passengers, a rise of 2.5 percent on the December 1995 total of 979,562.
The gross passenger load factor was up 3.7 percent to 80 percent. The available seat kilometres total was 9.2 percent up at 4,799,778 compared to 4,396,438 in December 1995.

Freight carried in the month was 8.6 percent up at 50,088 tonnes compared with 46,84O tonnes the year before. Available tonnes kilometres total rose eight percent from 811,732 in 1995 to 876,982 during December 1996.
